node_start.name: Engagement request received

provenance.excerpt: receives a request to act for a new client

node_start.description: An Engagement Manager receives a request to act for a new client.

node_capture_request.name: Log client request in CRM
node_capture_request.description: Log the new client request in the CRM with legal name, company number and requested service.

provenance.excerpt: The Engagement Manager logs the request in the CRM

node_capture_request.outcome: the client record is available for the KYC document request

node_request_docs.name: Request KYC documents
node_request_docs.description: Request certified photo ID and proof of address for each director and beneficial owner (25%+) and the certificate of incorporation.

provenance.excerpt: requests KYC documents from the client within one working day
Usually same day, worst case next day.

node_request_docs.outcome: the KYC document set is available for identity verification

node_wait_docs.name: Await client documents
node_wait_docs.description: Wait for the client to return the KYC document set.

provenance.excerpt: On receipt, the Onboarding Team verifies identity documents
What do we do when the client doesn't reply? Do we keep chasing indefinitely?

node_id_verify.name: Verify identity documents
node_id_verify.description: Verify each identity document through the electronic ID verification service.

provenance.excerpt: verifies identity documents using the approved electronic ID verification service

node_id_verify.outcome: verified identities are available for screening

node_screening.name: Screen company and individuals
node_screening.description: Screen the company, directors and beneficial owners against sanctions, PEP and adverse media sources and save results to the client file.

provenance.excerpt: screens the company and every director and beneficial owner against sanctions lists
Then we run the screening – sanctions, PEPs, adverse media

node_screening.outcome: the screening result is available for the client risk rating

node_risk_rate.name: Assign client risk rating
node_risk_rate.description: Apply the risk rating matrix to the screening result and client jurisdiction.

provenance.excerpt: assigns a client risk rating of Low, Medium or High using the risk rating matrix
it's the matrix for low and high

node_risk_rate.outcome: the risk assessment decides whether approval is needed before the conflict check

provenance.excerpt: Low-risk clients proceed directly to the conflict check

node_high_risk_approval.name: Approve high-risk client
node_high_risk_approval.description: Approve the engagement for a high-risk client before it proceeds. The Engagement Partner should escalate promptly if they have concerns.

provenance.excerpt: High-risk clients must be approved by the Engagement Partner before the engagement can proceed
high-risk approval is done by me as MLRO, not the engagement partner

meta.notes: Sources disagree on approver: SOP says Engagement Partner; MLRO (workshop) says MLRO since July policy change.

node_high_risk_approval.outcome: only approved high-risk clients proceed to the conflict check

node_conflict_check.name: Perform conflict and independence check
node_conflict_check.description: Check for conflicts of interest and independence issues for the new client.

provenance.excerpt: performs a conflict and independence check for every new client
The independence team then does the conflict check

node_conflict_check.outcome: only engagements without unmanageable conflicts are accepted

provenance.excerpt: If no conflict exists and the risk is acceptable, the engagement is accepted

node_engagement_letter.description: Issue the engagement letter to the client.

provenance.excerpt: Once accepted, the Engagement Manager issues the engagement letter
the engagement manager sends the letter

node_engagement_letter.outcome: the client is onboarded with an engagement letter

rule_risk_rating.name: Client risk rating matrix
rule_risk_rating.description: Rates client risk from screening results and jurisdiction.

provenance.excerpt: A client is rated High where any director is a PEP, or where screening returns significant adverse media
Medium is a bit of a judgement call, honestly.

logic.text: Accept if no conflict exists and the risk is acceptable; decline if a conflict cannot be managed.

provenance.excerpt: If no conflict exists and the risk is acceptable, the engagement is accepted

handling.notes: Ask the client for a valid replacement.

provenance.excerpt: Where an ID document has expired, the client is asked to provide a valid replacement.

exc_screening_service_down.name: Screening service unavailable
exc_screening_service_down.trigger: The screening service cannot be reached

provenance.excerpt: What happens if the screening service is down? Last month we lost two days.
We just wait, I think. Nobody's written that down.

sla_request_docs.name: Document request sent within 1 working day

provenance.excerpt: within one working day of the CRM request being logged
Usually same day, worst case next day.
completed within 10 working days of the request being logged

meta.notes: Breach action confirmed by Daniel Okafor during canvas walkthrough 30 Sep.

ac_capture_request.title: New client request is logged
given: an Engagement Manager has received a request to act for a new client
when: they log the request in the CRM
then: a client record exists with legal name, company number and requested service

provenance.excerpt: recording the client legal name, company number and the requested service

ac_request_docs.title: KYC documents requested on time
given: a client request has been logged in the CRM
when: the Onboarding Team requests KYC documents
then: the request is sent to the client within 1 working day of the CRM request being logged
the request lists photo ID and proof of address for each director and beneficial owner holding 25% or more, and the certificate of incorporation

provenance.excerpt: requests KYC documents from the client within one working day

ac_id_verified.title: Identity documents verified
given: a complete KYC document set has been received
when: the Onboarding Team verifies the identity documents
then: a verification result is recorded for each director and beneficial owner

provenance.excerpt: verifies identity documents using the approved electronic ID verification service

ac_id_expired.title: Expired ID triggers replacement request
given: a KYC document set containing an expired photo ID
then: the client is asked to provide a valid replacement
the case returns to the document request step

provenance.excerpt: Where an ID document has expired, the client is asked to provide a valid replacement.

ac_screening_complete.title: Screening completed and filed
then: the company and every director and beneficial owner have been screened against sanctions, PEP and adverse media sources
all screening results are saved to the client file

provenance.excerpt: All screening results are saved to the client file.

ac_risk_rating_high.title: PEP director gives High rating
given: a screening result where a director is a PEP
when: the client risk rating is assigned
then: the client risk rating is High

provenance.excerpt: A client is rated High where any director is a PEP

ac_risk_rating_low.title: Clean screening gives Low rating
given: a screening result with no PEP matches and no adverse media
when: the client risk rating is assigned
then: the client risk rating is Low
the case proceeds to the conflict check

provenance.excerpt: A client is rated Low where there are no PEP matches, no adverse media

ac_high_risk_approval.title: High-risk client needs approval
then: the engagement does not proceed to the conflict check until approval is recorded
the approver's decision is saved to the client file

provenance.excerpt: must be approved by the Engagement Partner before the engagement can proceed

ac_conflict_check.title: Conflict check gates acceptance
given: a client rated Low, or rated High and approved
when: the Independence Team performs the conflict and independence check
then: the engagement is accepted only if no unmanageable conflict exists

provenance.excerpt: performs a conflict and independence check for every new client

ac_engagement_letter.title: Engagement letter issued within SLA
when: the Engagement Manager issues the engagement letter
then: an engagement letter is issued to the client
the letter is issued within 10 working days of the request being logged

provenance.excerpt: completed within 10 working days of the request being logged

term_beneficial_owner.definition: An individual holding 25% or more of the client.

provenance.excerpt: beneficial owner holding 25% or more
should escalate promptly if they have concerns
where screening returns significant adverse media
